caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest with a flat, overhanging lid. The chest is rendered in shades of brown, giving the appearance of natural wood grain. The front and side panels each feature heart-shaped cutouts or inlays, outlined in a lighter off-white color, with small decorative leaf-like motifs painted in yellow and beige scattered around the hearts. The composition is centered, with the chest shown in three-quarter view so that the front and right side are both visible. The background is a plain, light beige, with no additional objects or landscape elements, highlighting the chest as the sole subject of the image. The artist’s signature, "J.H. McCallum," is visible near the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Pa. German Box
